title: Latent Heat
definition: Latent heat is the heat energy absorbed or released by a substance during a constant-temperature phase change (e.g., solid to liquid, liquid to gas), wherein the added energy alters molecular potential energy rather than kinetic energy or temperature.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for General Studies Paper I (Climatology, thermodynamics of the atmosphere, tropical cyclones, and monsoon energetics) and General Studies Paper III (Science & Technology - fundamental physics and industrial applications).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Latent Heat.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Core physics concepts of temperature, heat transfer, and states of matter
